title: Grimwood
description: Adds a mysterious creature with the name of Grimwood Reaper. He is a myth, living in the Grimwood Forest. People have reported that he is very dangerous.
body:
## **This mod requires GeckoLib**
 

# _Grimwood Reaper_
 

![The Grimwood Reaper is a mysterious creature living in the Grimwood Forest. For centuries, this mysterious being has hunted anyone who dares enter the depths of the forest, its presence remembered only through whispered legends.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4029b8b07af8a0711141c3a9efe762a498df1b47_0.webp)
![The Grimwood Reaper is a mysterious creature living in the Grimwood Forest. For centuries, this mysterious being has hunted anyone who dares enter the depths of the forest, its presence remembered only through whispered legends.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee6bc20fa04706ae634c1e3cb74263e49a365744.png)![The Grimwood Reaper is a mysterious creature living in the Grimwood Forest. For centuries, this mysterious being has hunted anyone who dares enter the depths of the forest, its presence remembered only through whispered legends.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/daab982fbcc90cc9f49b5f5afbb8e0d31b854f7a.png)



The Grimwood Reaper is a mysterious creature living in the Grimwood Forest. For centuries, this mysterious being has hunted anyone who dares enter the depths of the forest, its presence remembered only through whispered legends.
 

Currently this mod has only one creature (The Grimwood Reaper), but in the future there is much more to come!

 

Join our [discord](https://discord.gg/Vay2QjxZGp) to follow on development progress and share your ideas through suggestions, polls, and community discussions.
